business_summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited produces and supplies dairy products. It engages in food processing, and manufacturing and trading of food products. The company provides dairy products including cheese, paneer, butter, curd, ghee, yogurt, ice cream, milk cream, and UHT milk products. It also offers ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook products, such as frozen pizza, paneer crunchies, paneer tikka, paneer finger, dahi tikki, cheese balls, wheat chapati, malabar parota, coin parota, ragi, idly and dosa batter, and various payasam mix; chocolates and sweetened condensed milk; and traditional Indian sweets such as shrikhand, kalakhand, payasam, mishti doi, and rasgulla. In addition, the company provides beverages, includes lassi, milkshakes, buttermilk, and flavored yogurts; cream, milk powder, flavoured milk, lassi, etc.; and khova. It sells its products under the Milky Mist, Smartchef, Capella, Briyas, and Asal brand names. The company also exports its products to Australia, Bahrain, Brunei, Congo, Ghana, Hong Kong, Kuwait, Maldives, Mauritius, New Zealand, Nigeria, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Seychelles, Singapore, Sri Lanka, the United Arab Emirates, and the United States. Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Perundurai, India.
